title: spec(ui): the `object-grid` `defaultFilters` and element flat-binding tombstones say "removed in @objectstack/spec 17", but 17.7.0 shipped those keys live; the v18 train removes them in 18
body:
Filing gate **①**, release text fixed at release: the filing gate's named exception, wrong text a release freezes into every refusal and JSON Schema `describe`. reach: the public door `os validate`, measured by #23026's dev on a `defineStack` fixture carrying `object-grid` `properties.defaultFilters` (report `6137329814`). It prints "`object-grid` property `defaultFilters` was removed in @objectstack/spec 17", and since PR #23140 that line is an `error`. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 (#18883) · `os-support-ai` · session `session_012uFegdfR6K6uqvLzt7XsdZ`, from that report's out-of-scope finding. ⛔ Not a claim; lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:spec` seat, before #21988 (`18.0.0-next.0`) merges: the text ships in `src/**/*.zod.ts`, in the JSON Schema `describe` and in every refusal.

## The evidence

- **Tag `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0`** (`4e4e88142`, read by this seat): `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:4498` declares `defaultFilters` LIVE, `z.array(ViewFilterRuleSchema, …)`. So 17.7.0 did not remove it.
- **`origin/main` `287fd6e5d`:**
  - The `object-grid` `defaultFilters` tombstone names "@objectstack/spec 17".
  - The helper `elementFlatBindingRetired` (`component.zod.ts:3045`) renders "`TYPE` property `KEY` was removed in @objectstack/spec 17 (ADR-0087 D2)". It covers `element:number` `object` / `filter`, `element:record_picker` `object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit` and `element:repeater` `object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit`. Per the dev's tarball reading, every one of them is live in 17.7.0 (`ElementNumberPropsSchema`, `ElementRecordPickerPropsSchema`, `ElementRepeaterPropsSchema`).
  - Their ADR-0087 entries say `toMajor: 18`, `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`.
- **Control:** `page:header` `breadcrumb`, `object-grid` `defaultSort` and `object-kanban` `quickAdd` were already tombstoned in 17.7.0, so their "17" is right.

## Governing text

- `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key.ts`, `@param guidance`: "State what replaced the key, the version that removed it, and the one-line fix — this string IS the migration doc for anyone who hits it."
- History, so the direction is not mistaken for a regression of #18048: that card (closed 2026-09-22) moved "18" to "17.x", because the 17.x line shipped every retirement as `minor`. The v18 train runs in pre mode (`.changeset/pre.json`: `pre` / `next`) and ships a breaking retirement as `major`, so the first release that refuses a v18-train retirement is `18.0.0`.

## The ask

A family closing card, ⛔ not a point fix. Every tombstone whose ADR-0087 entry is `toMajor: 18` names `18` as the removal version, and its `os migrate meta --from N` sentence agrees. The enumeration nail is: join each `toMajor: 18` registry entry to its tombstone guidance, list every one naming `17`, and fix all of them in one PR. The PR body carries that list and its count.

## Duplicate check

REST issue list of objectstack-ai/objectstack, `state=all`, updated since 2026-09-01 (4,078 issues over 81 pages, stopped at the short page). Local match for "removed in @objectstack/spec 17|18", `elementFlatBindingRetired`, or `retiredKey` near "wrong/mismatch/stale version": 10 hits, all closed. The nearest are #18048 (the opposite direction, above) and its duplicate #18059. Control, `retiredKey` alone: 60 hits.

Dedupe words: retired key prescription wrong version; removed in @objectstack/spec 17 defaultFilters; elementFlatBindingRetired version; tombstone guidance major mismatch; retiredAfter 17.7.0 toMajor 18 prescription.
